voice: That camp. Somebody sat there too long. Go and look.

clues.mule: The mule lies dead in its traces. Hoofprints lead off into the reeds, wide apart, running.
clues.tracks: Hoofprints, wide apart. Something ran from here as fast as it could, and it was not the mule.

voice: Somebody left in a hurry. Or didn't.

again: Mind the sheep. They mind nobody.
herder.gift: Here. Bread's yesterday's, but it's bread.
voice: A herder. Sheep don't care who's watching. I envied them once.
herder.warning: Keep off the ridges today. There were men in grey up there at first light, asking at every fire.

clues.pack: A pack lies in the road, its straps cut. Needles spill out of it. Of the man who carried it, nothing.

voice: You walked on. So did I, once.

pedlar.greeting: A trade or two, then I'm gone. Strangers bring trouble, and I've had my share.
voice: A pedlar. Count your fingers after you shake his hand.

ask.text: On the road ahead, three men in grey stand around a traveller on his knees.
Seen anyone with a coal in their hand that glows? A fire that walks?
I've seen nothing! I sell needles, that's all!

choices.reply: You step out onto the road.
You get off the road and into the trees.
You keep walking. Behind you, nobody calls out.

hid.text: Nothing, he says. Take his purse for the lie.
They take his purse and walk on, laughing.
I saw you in the trees! I hope it finds you, whatever you are!

voice: They're asking after you. Don't stand there.

won.text: You... you came out for me. Nobody comes out.
Listen. Past the hill there's a burnt-out place. Whoever lived there buried what they had. Nobody came back for it.

ridge.seen: On the ridge, a line of figures in grey, walking. None of them looks down.
voice: Gazebound. The heir's people. Keep low and let them pass.

clues.traveller: A traveller lies by the road, opened over the heart, like the dead in Tollbridge. The purse on the belt is still full.

voice: They walked alone, at night. Don't.
Somebody's bridge, or the wind's. Mind your feet.

wolves.seen: Wolves on the ridge, keeping pace. They don't come closer.
